import asyncio
import httpx
import time

async def test():
    base_url = ''https://96c3f93672471.notebooks.jarvislabs.net''
    
    prompt = ''''''/no_think
Analyze this log telemetry and classify it:

081110 150238 31 INFO dfs.FSNamesystem: BLOCK* NameSystem.addStoredBlock: blockMap updated: 10.251.38.197:50010

Respond with JSON ONLY (no explanation):
{""anomaly_detected"": true/false, ""severity"": ""critical/warning/info"", ""category"": ""error/normal/...""}''''''
    
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120.0) as client:
        start = time.time()
        response = await client.post(
            f''{base_url}/v1/chat/completions'',
            json={
                ''model'': ''qwen3:4b'',
                ''messages'': [
                    {''role'': ''system'', ''content'': ''You are a telemetry annotator. Respond with JSON only.''},
                    {''role'': ''user'', ''content'': prompt}
                ],
                ''max_tokens'': 2048,
                ''temperature'': 0.0,
                ''stream'': False
            }
        )
        elapsed = time.time() - start
        data = response.json()
        
        content = data[''choices''][0][''message''][''content'']
        tokens = data.get(''usage'', {}).get(''completion_tokens'', 0)
        
        print(f''Time: {elapsed:.2f}s'')
        print(f''Tokens: {tokens}'')
        print(f''Has </think>: {""</think>"" in content}'')
        
        if ''</think>'' in content:
            answer = content.split(''</think>'', 1)[-1].strip()
            print(f''Answer: {answer[:200]}'')
        else:
            print(f''Raw (first 300): {content[:300]}'')

asyncio.run(test())
")
